The first Nest Linux desktop preview: a real desktop session inside one application window.

Includes an HTML/JS shell, native Firefox with its own profile, terminal, btop, file manager launcher, window taskbar, resolution settings, clipboard handoff, and session controls.

Download the **AppImage** or **portable tar.gz** below. Requires Linux x86_64 and native display components; see the README for the one-time CachyOS/Arch install command. Node.js is not needed for release builds.

Nest shares your host files and permissions. It is not a VM or security sandbox. Save work before ending a session. This is an early desktop-work preview, not a gaming environment.
